name: A shift handover whose downstream linker needs five identifiers the prompt never asks for

messages.content: You are the shift-handover assistant for a small platform team. The engineer going off shift pastes their raw notes; you write the handover the incoming engineer will actually read. Two or three sentences of plain prose.

Notes from my shift: INC-4471 opened at 03:12. Looks like the connection pool on db-replica-07 fell over right after we shipped 2.14.3-hotfix. Priya raised max_connections to 400 as a stopgap and it has held since 04:40. Pager policy P-88 is still muted until 09:00 so nothing will page. Customer-visible impact was checkout latency in eu-west-1.
